scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/search build && corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && tsc -b
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/search build && corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && vitest run && corepack pnpm run test:d1-runtime
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/search build && corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:d1-runtime: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/search build && corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && tsc -b && vitest run --config vitest.config.d1-runtime.ts
scripts.d1:import:local: corepack pnpm run d1:export-sql && wrangler d1 execute karaoke-songs --local --file .wrangler/import/songs-d1.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: node scripts/guard-remote-d1.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply karaoke-songs --remote
scripts.d1:import:remote: node scripts/guard-remote-d1.mjs && corepack pnpm run d1:export-sql && node scripts/import-d1-remote-chunked.mjs
scripts.d1:verify-sql: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && node scripts/export-d1-sql.mjs && node scripts/report-d1-sql-metrics.mjs .wrangler/import/songs-d1.sql
scripts.sqlite:build: corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/search build && corepack pnpm --filter @karaoke/data-store build && node scripts/build-sqlite-db.mjs
